# laravelforge_site_deployment_status (Data Source)

Fetches the current deployment status of a Laravel Forge site (read-only singleton).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server the site runs on.
- `site_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the site.

### Read-Only

- `started_at` (String) Timestamp the current deployment started.
- `status` (String) Current deployment status (one of `cancelled`, `deploying`, `failed`, `failed-build`, `finished`, `pending`, `queued`); null when no deployment has run.
